transcript.text: Thank you, Noah. That's an important finding on the GPLv3 issue. Now I'd like to share my commercial review finding. While reviewing the build, I confirmed that the largest customer's proprietary connector is included in the current build of the Atlas toolkit. I reviewed that customer's source-code agreement, and it expressly prohibits public release of the connector without written customer consent. This means the public package must exclude the connector and be limited to the core toolkit only. I have not yet added this contract restriction to the release checklist, which is why I'm disclosing it to the group now so we can address it before the release proceeds.
